name: synth_audio
description: Synthesize a 48 kHz stereo WAV from a cue list of generic voices placed at exact times: kick, snare, hat, bass, sub, pad, pluck, whoosh, hit, click, riser. Each cue: {t, voice, dur?, note? (MIDI), freq?, gain? 0-2, pan? -1..1}. Deterministic for a given seed. Peak limited to -1 dBFS.
